items.reason: Same claim that malformed OAuth state causes an uncaught JSON.parse exception and a 500 in OAuth handlers.
Claims the webhook's shared-secret authorization permits arbitrary users' credential overwrites without stronger authentication or replay protection. No rejected issue describes this cause.
Same claim that the webhook falls back to an empty encryption key when CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY is unset instead of failing fast.
Claims the documented key-generation command produces a key length inconsistent with the stated AES256 requirement. This differs from the rejected missing-environment-variable fallback claim.
Same claim that the JSDoc incorrectly describes appData.type as the app slug.
Same malformed-state JSON.parse exception claim in decodeOAuthState. The additional reference to encodeOAuthState does not change the central asserted defect.
